# Shared graph module: node cards, status animation, zoom/fit and keyboard shortcuts

## What to build

Both pages draw their dependency graph with hand-built SVG and copied pan/zoom code:

- `src/web/page.html`:
  - `renderGraph(s)` L248–311 computes the layered layout inline. Nodes are 180×46 (`NODE_W`/`NODE_H` L146–165).
  - pan/zoom L312–378: `view{x,y,k}`, `applyView`, `fit`, `zoomAt`, `setupCanvas`
- `src/suite/page.html`:
  - `layout(m)` L346 and `renderGraph` L384 (feature "clusters", with task nodes inside)
  - pan/zoom L449–525

This slice extracts a shared `src/web/assets/graph.js` module, and makes the graph look and feel like a modern "mission control" canvas.

1. **Pure layout**: `layoutLayers(layers, parents, {nodeW, nodeH, gapX, gapY, pad})` → `{nodes: Map<id,{x,y}>, width, height, edges:[{from,to,points}]}`. It is unit-tested. The suite page keeps its cluster layout, but uses the shared edge path and the canvas code.
2. **Canvas controller**: `createCanvas(svgHost, {onSelect})` gives:
   - pan (drag), wheel zoom at the cursor, and pinch with the trackpad's ctrl+wheel
   - `fit()`, `zoomBy(f)` and `reset()`
   - floating controls `−`, `+`, `Fit`, `1:1` at the bottom right of the canvas
   - keyboard: `F` fits, `+`/`=` and `-` zoom, `0` resets. Shortcuts are ignored while an input or textarea has focus.
   - it fits on first load, and after a resize of the graph container (ResizeObserver) unless the user panned since
3. **Node cards** of 220×64:
   - line 1: a status icon and the title, truncated with a `<title>` tooltip
   - line 2: the run's provider, the node's elapsed time, the attempt (`×2` when attempts > 1), and `+x −y` in green/red from `view.changes.total`
4. **Status styles**: CSS classes on the node group, `node s-<status>`.

   | Status | Style |
   |---|---|
   | pending | dim outline |
   | running | accent glow pulse (2s `@keyframes`) |
   | validating, fixing | amber glow |
   | merged, done | green check with a solid border |
   | failed | red ring and ⚠ |
   | skipped | dashed outline |

   - An edge whose target is running gets `edge active`, with flowing dashes (an animated `stroke-dashoffset`).
   - An edge out of a failed node is dimmed.
   - The selected node gets an accent outline.
5. **Per-node elapsed time.** There is no per-node start time today. `NodeView` (`src/ui/store.ts` L30–46) only has `status`, `attempt`, `attempts`, `label`, `round`, `rounds`, `changes` and `testPlan`. Add `startedAt?: number` (ms) and `endedAt?: number` to `NodeView`:
   - set `startedAt` the first time a node becomes `running`
   - set `endedAt` when it reaches `done`, `merged`, `failed` or `skipped`
   - the page shows `endedAt ?? now` minus `startedAt`

   The suite page's `FeatureView` has no times, so feature cards show the elapsed time only if `startedAt` exists in the data. Otherwise they leave it out.

The previous slice delivered `/assets/*` on both servers, `src/web/assets/theme.css` (tokens like `--accent`, `--ok`, `--warn`, `--bad`, `--panel`, `--border`, `--glow`, `--font-ui`, `--font-code`, plus the `prefers-reduced-motion` rule), `allowJs` for tests, and eslint for `src/web/assets/**/*.js`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/page.html`:
  - L34–57: graph/zoom/node CSS
  - L140: `#graph` with `#zoom(#zout,#zin,#zfit)`
  - L146–165: constants `NODE_W`, `NODE_H`, `GAP_X`, `GAP_Y`, `PAD`, `ACTIVE`, `COLOR`, `ICON`
  - L248–378: `renderGraph` and pan/zoom
  - L1035–1076: `main()`, with the graph click handler that selects a node and opens the panel
- `src/web/page.html` L280–303: today's node card (title, icon or spinner, `statusText`, `+added −deleted`, retry badge). Keep the information it shows.
- `src/suite/page.html` L144–164 (constants), L296–448 (`buildModel`, `layout`, `renderGraph`), L449–525 (pan/zoom).
- `src/ui/store.ts`:
  - L8–17: `NodeStatus`
  - L30–46: `NodeView`
  - the reducer that sets `status` (search `status:` / `"running"`)
  - `src/ui/store.test.ts`: the test style
- `src/web/server.ts` L101–119: `snapshot()`, which includes `meta.provider` and `startedAt` (run level) and `graph.nodes[{id,title,view}]`.

## Patterns to follow

**Module convention**: `// @ts-check`, JSDoc, pure functions first. `layoutLayers` must not touch the DOM.

**SVG creation**: keep `document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", tag)`, as both pages do today (`el()` in the run page, `svgEl()` in the suite page). Export a shared `svg(tag, attrs, ...children)` helper.

**Store change (TypeScript):**
```ts
// NodeView
startedAt?: number; // ms epoch, first time the node became running
endedAt?: number;   // ms epoch, when it reached done/merged/failed/skipped
```
Use `Date.now()` in the reducer. If the store already takes a clock for tests, inject it the same way, and check the constructor first.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `src/ui/store.ts` and `src/ui/store.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `startedAt`/`endedAt` as above. A test drives a node pending → running → done and checks both are set, and that a retry (running again) keeps the first `startedAt`.
- **GOTCHA**: the Ink terminal UI (`src/ui/Graph.tsx`) reads `NodeView` too. Optional fields don't break it, so leave the terminal UI unchanged.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/ui`

### CREATE `src/web/assets/graph.js` and `src/web/assets/graph.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `layoutLayers`
  - `edgePath(a, b)` (a bezier)
  - `renderNodeCard(view, opts)`
  - `createCanvas(host, opts)`, which returns `{svg, root, fit, zoomBy, reset, setContent(width, height)}`
  - `nodeClass(status)`
  - CSS: card styles (glass fill `var(--panel)`, 1px `var(--border)`, 10px radius), status classes, `@keyframes pulse` and `@keyframes flow`, the canvas dot-grid background (`radial-gradient(var(--faint) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/22px 22px`), and the floating `.zoombar` (glass, bottom right)
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `renderGraph` uses `layoutLayers` and `renderNodeCard` (with `provider` from the snapshot and the elapsed time from `startedAt`/`endedAt`)
  - pan/zoom uses `createCanvas`
  - remove the old pan/zoom code and the `#zoom` buttons, which are replaced by `.zoombar`
  - node clicks still select the node and open the panel
  - the elapsed times on cards refresh with the existing 1s timer
- **GOTCHA**: the page's script is a module from the diff-module slice only if that slice landed first. If the script is still classic, convert it to `type="module"` here, and wire any inline handlers with `addEventListener`.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then agent-browser: a run in progress (fake script `hang` on task 3, per TESTING.md) shows the running node pulsing and its incoming edges animated. `F` fits.

### UPDATE `src/suite/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: use `createCanvas` and `edgePath`, and the same card and status styles for task nodes. Feature clusters get a glass frame with the feature name and status. Delete the copied pan/zoom code.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then `demo/suite/run.sh`, with an agent-browser screenshot.

### CREATE `src/web/assets/graph.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `layoutLayers` places the diamond fixture (`[["1"],["2","3"],["4"]]`, parents `{2:["1"],3:["1"],4:["2","3"]}`) in 3 columns; nodes in a layer are centred vertically; width and height include the padding; there is one edge per parent link. `nodeClass` maps every `NodeStatus`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both pages use `src/web/assets/graph.js` for the canvas, and neither page has its own pan/zoom code
- [ ] Node cards (220×64) show the status icon, title, provider, elapsed time, attempt `×n` and `+x −y`
- [ ] Running nodes pulse, and edges into running nodes animate; failed nodes have a red ring; animations stop with `prefers-reduced-motion`
- [ ] The floating zoom bar and the `F` / `+` / `-` / `0` keys work, and keys are ignored while typing in an input
- [ ] `NodeView.startedAt`/`endedAt` are set by the store, and the existing terminal UI tests pass
- [ ] `npx vitest run src/web/assets src/ui && npm test` pass
- [ ] Agent-browser screenshots of a running run (run page) and of the suite page are in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web src/ui
npm run build
```
